name: esqharness
description: AI safeguards for U.S. lawyers inside Claude: checks case citations and quotations against the CourtListener case-law database, finds a court's AI rules and drafts the AI-use disclosure, loads the firm's own AI rules, and runs the ESQ AI Practice Risk Check. The attorney stays responsible for the final work. Not legal advice.

firm_code.title: EsqHarness firm code (optional)
firm_code.description: The 36-character code after t= at the end of your EsqHarness connector link, from your EsqHarness welcome email. With it, your firm's AI rules load and each check is added to your firm's monthly record. Leave it empty to use the checks without a firm record.
